name: copilot-orchestrator-v1
description: Orchestrator-only evaluation scenarios. Each scenario constructs the graph state the orchestrator node sees and checks the single decision it makes — no sub-agents are invoked. Categories: initial_routing (20: routing straight after START), after_booking_response (10: dummy booking agent output present, what does it decide), after_kb_response (10: dummy knowledge base output present), empty_agent_response (10: an agent was called but returned nothing), irrelevant (10: queries no sub-agent should handle). expected.decisions is a list of acceptable decisions; a decision with return_to_user=true ignores tool calls (production routing does too). reference_response, when non-empty, is a known-good reply used to judge relevancy of the produced response.
